Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — AcmeCloud leadership liked the latency/cost story. We'd like to start the GCP Marketplace listing process and get procurement details in a single thread so our finance team can review. Initial asks from our side:

- Your preferred DocuSign SOW template and any vendor questionnaire answers you can share.

I've attached our standard SOW and the vendor questionnaire to speed things up (Acme-SOW.pdf, vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). cc'd our procurement alias. Please let me know who on your side owns the seller onboarding and the procurement touchpoint.

Alex — thanks for the note and the attachments. I'll own the commercial coordination and loop in Marissa for procurement ops and Jordan for billing mapping. Quick outline of next steps from our side: 

1) Procurement intake: Marissa will send our seller intake checklist and the DocuSign SOW template.
2) Technical listing: we'll run a short preflight (model artifact check + SKU/entitlement mapping) that Jordan can own.
3) PO flow: we accept PO numbers for marketplace purchases; we will send invoice to the billing contact on the PO.
4) SLA/credits: we have standard credits for sustained downtime beyond the SLA; I'll get a redline-ready clause to share.

Can you confirm: first, the billing entity name exactly as it should appear on the invoice; second, your preferred go-live target (we usually plan 3-4 weeks for listing + procurement signoff).

Cc'ed Marissa and Jordan to pick up the attachments.

Hi Alex — welcome! Attaching our Marketplace procurement checklist which lays out the onboarding gates and required docs. Highlights:

- Required: Signed SOW (DocuSign), W-9 or equivalent, procurement contact + PO (if AcmeCloud uses PO flow).
- Optional but helpful: SOC2 evidence or link to security questionnaire answers (we can provide a redacted bundle).
- Billing mapping: we need SKU-to-contract mapping; Jordan will add the draft mapping below.

DocuSign link for our standard SOW: https://www.docusign.com/links/abcdef123456

If AcmeCloud prefers invoice instead of PO, let us know — that changes payment terms but not listing timeline. I'll also flag a typical procurement cadence: 1 week review (legal + finance) once SOW + PO are in place, then 1–2 weeks for marketplace technical validation.
